basics.label: Revenue Cycle Managing Consultant | Epic Back-End RCM | PB/HB | A/R & Denials Transformation
basics.summary: Healthcare revenue-cycle transformation leader with 12+ years across U.S. RCM operations, business analysis, client advisory, analytics, credentialing, automation, and systems optimization. Brings 5+ cumulative years of hands-on Epic revenue-cycle experience across multi-platform portfolios, including Resolute PB/HB workflows, workqueues, claim edits, denials, A/R, payment and remittance, underpayments, collections, and reporting. Combines frontline back-end RCM depth with current-state assessment, future-state design, KPI governance, multidisciplinary delivery, and executive communication.
